name: Manufacture Order Checklist
description: The Manufacture Order Checklist module enhances Odoo’s Manufacturing (MRP) workflow by adding structured, customizable checklists to Manufacturing Orders (MOs). It ensures that all required steps—such as raw material verification, machine setup, safety checks, and QA review—are followed before, during, or after production.
